name: MSG_JAMS_STATION_ACTIVE
meaning: from TrafficJams, arg = ARRIVINGTIME: registers it; returns state != 0

name: MSG_TRAIN_WAYPOINT
meaning: from Train/BipbipLevel14: waypoint reached (arg out: next station at route end); also sent to the train as 'go to waypoint'

name: MSG_STATION_BEGIN_ROUTE
meaning: from Train, state 0: start the route at point 0

name: MSG_STATION_QUERY_TRAIN_ZONE
meaning: from Train/Bipbip, state 1: forwards train msg 0x4785
